name: wazuh
title: Wazuh
description: Pulls vulnerability findings from a Wazuh manager via its REST API. Provide WAZUH_URL (e.g. https://wazuh.example:55000), WAZUH_USERNAME, and WAZUH_PASSWORD as agent env vars. Per-scan, set WAZUH_AGENT_IDS (CSV of Wazuh agent IDs to query — '000' for the manager itself) and optionally WAZUH_MIN_SEVERITY (Low/Medium/High/Critical).
